FG syndrome is neurodevelopmental; metopic synostosis and strabismus each reported in 1/1 patient. Constipation alone does not establish intestinal damage.
Inflammation of the larynx and trachea; infectious classification is supported by the supplied ancestry.
Spinal cord dysfunction caused by disease of its vascular supply.
Oculocutaneous albinism defines skin and ocular abnormalities and disordered melanin metabolism; additional systemic damage varies by syndrome.
Severe keratinization disorder; fixed flexion contractures occur in 30-79%. Recurrent skin infections are secondary infections; autoamputation occurs in <30%.
Primary cutaneous T-cell lymphoid neoplasia; skin is the site of origin, with haematologic and lymphoma mechanism axes.
Congenital absence or hypoplasia of the iris; extraocular abnormalities are not shared across isolated and syndromic forms.
Intellectual disability with cortical abnormalities and paresis; strabismus occurs in 7/7. Reflux and nephrotic syndrome do not establish direct multisystem damage.
Cystic leukoencephalopathy defines CNS damage; sensorineural hearing impairment and strabismus each occur in 30-79%.
Umbrella for developmental abnormalities caused by metabolic disease; no additional organ is consistently affected across the group.
The defining syndrome combines gingival and conjunctival amyloidosis with intellectual disability.
Isolated developmental malformation of the cerebellum and posterior fossa, explicitly without hydrocephalus.
Inherited retinal dystrophy; the retinal location determines the ocular axis.
Hypoplasia, atrophy and neurodegeneration of the pons and cerebellum define the group; other organ abnormalities are subtype-dependent.
Tumour of ovarian granulosa cells, the hormone-producing sex cord-stromal compartment; classified as an endocrine gland neoplasm.
Benign smooth muscle tumour arising in the urinary bladder; visceral smooth muscle origin does not imply locomotor disease.
The oral cavity is the predominant site across this histologic group. Laryngeal, cutaneous and reproductive sites vary by subtype and are not shared damage.
Developmental disability and characteristic hair/sweat abnormalities; visual impairment 17/22, skeletal delay/hypermobility 80-99%. Dental eruption delay omitted at cap.
Supplied definition describes optic disc edema/papilledema; raised intracranial pressure does not itself establish brain damage or an immune mechanism.
Leukocyte adhesion dysfunction causes immunodeficiency and platelet dysfunction causes bleeding. Osteopetrosis is <30%; hepatomegaly alone is not liver damage.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with defining sleep apnea; structural malformations, prominently contractures, scoliosis and talipes, affect most. Cleft palate frequency unclear.
Cardiac conduction disorder defined by short PR interval and atrial tachyarrhythmias.
Distal tubular acidification failure causes metabolic acidosis; sensorineural hearing loss occurs in 9/23 (~39%). Rickets 2/9 (~22%) is below threshold.
Thrombosis of a dural venous sinus. Ear infection is a separate precipitating disease; headache and intracranial pressure do not establish direct brain damage.
